add_or_update_subscriber.description: Add someone by email, such as from a sign-up form or a purchase, or update them if they're already there: add lists and attributes, keeping the rest.
add_or_update_subscriber.name: add_or_update_subscriber

parameters.description: Their email address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Their name. Leave blank to keep theirs, or for a new subscriber to take it from their email address.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Lists to subscribe them to. They stay on lists they're already on, and stay unsubscribed from any they left.
parameters.name: lists

parameters.description: Extra details to keep on them, such as city: Leeds or plan: pro. Added to theirs, replacing any with the same name.
parameters.name: attributes

parameters.description: Turn on only if the person has already agreed to hear from you: their subscriptions are confirmed without emailing them. Off, listmonk emails a confirmation link for a double opt-in list.
parameters.name: confirmed

attributes.description: Their attributes: extra details such as city or plan

blocklisted.description: Whether they're blocklisted, so never emailed

created.description: True if they were added, false if they were already there

link.description: A link to them in listmonk

list_names.description: The lists they're subscribed to (not unsubscribed from)

lists.description: Every list they're on, with their status there

optin.description: single or double: whether the list asks people to confirm

uuid.description: Their UUID, as in their unsubscribe links

create_campaign.description: Make a campaign (a newsletter) for lists, as a draft to send or schedule with Send campaign.
create_campaign.name: create_campaign

parameters.description: The email's subject line.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The lists to send it to.
parameters.name: lists

parameters.description: What the email says, written in the format you pick.
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: What the body is written in.
parameters.name: body_format

parameters.description: Its name in listmonk. Leave blank to use the subject.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The design it's sent in. Leave blank for listmonk's default.
parameters.name: template

parameters.description: Who it's from, such as Acme <news@acme.example>. Leave blank for listmonk's default.
parameters.name: from_email

parameters.description: Tags to file it under.
parameters.name: tags

clicks.description: How many times links in it were clicked

format.description: What the body is written in: markdown, html, richtext or plain

link.description: A link to it in listmonk

list_ids.description: The IDs of the lists it goes to

lists.description: The names of the lists it goes to

send_at.description: When it's scheduled to send (ISO 8601); empty if not

sent.description: How many it has been sent to

started_at.description: When it started sending (ISO 8601); empty if not yet

status.description: draft, scheduled, running, paused, cancelled or finished

to_send.description: How many subscribers it's going to

views.description: How many times it was opened
